answer_1.quote: Despite the great advances of Machine Translation (MT) models over the past years, the adequacy and fluency of the translations cannot be guaranteed.

answer_2.quote: In QE, the best practice is to use Pearson's r to measure performance.

answer_4.quote: Each sentence pair was judged on a scale from 0-100 by at least 3 evaluators. The reported DA score is the mean of the individual judgements.
answer_4.guideline: Different than the HTER scores, the DA scale provides a measure of the severity of the errors, where inadequate (i.e. non-meaning preserving) translations should not receive a score higher than 70, even if only one word is incorrect.
